key_insight: BubbleSH provides a compact, high-fidelity benchmark for learning the coupled motion and deformation of interacting bubbles in chaotic multiphase flow.
engineering_relevance: The dataset supports development and evaluation of data-driven bubbly-flow simulators for applications where bubble shape, interactions, and trajectory prediction matter.
method: Direct numerical simulations of rising bubbles in a periodic domain
Time-resolved recording of 3D trajectories, velocities, and shape evolution
Bubble morphology encoded compactly with spherical harmonics
evidence_signal: The abstract reports time-resolved bubble-swarm data plus dedicated metrics for both trajectory and shape prediction, and evaluates a permutation- and translation-equivariant probabilistic emulator.
watch_item: Because the dynamics are highly sensitive to local perturbations, models may be difficult to train and validate reliably outside the sampled simulation conditions.
paper_title: BubbleSH: A Dataset of Rising Bubbles with Deformable Interfaces
